tags.name: Snake Island
tags.qa_notes: 2026-08-22 RE-AUDIT: Re-pulled all three sources. Advanced/drift classification, plateau depth, and sea krait population reconfirmed unchanged. Added one new sourced fact to markdown, corroborated by two independent sources (Dive Scotty and Valm Divers): the reef is recovering from past dynamite fishing damage. Dive Scotty and Valm Divers both mention 'sharks and dolphins' as possible incidental sightings (not whale sharks specifically) — kept as-is, still described as unconfirmed/occasional, not a species list. No hallucinations found. || 2026-06-25: MAJOR CORRECTION — Difficulty upgraded Beginner→Advanced: SM Divers explicitly says 'not a site for absolute beginners' and 'advanced guests or experienced divers comfortable in drift conditions.' Valm Divers rates it Advanced. Strong sweeping surface currents. Site type changed reef→drift: it's a seamount/sunken plateau with strong currents, best characterized as a drift site. Plateau top at 12-15m, drops to 60m+. Thresher shark claim removed — thresher sharks are a Malapascua phenomenon (Kimud Shoal), not confirmed at Cervera Shoal. Marine life confirmed: black-and-white banded sea kraits (Laticauda colubrina), white-eyed morays, starry morays, nudibranchs, bucket sponges. validation_source upgraded from 'gap_fill' to three independent sources.
